free.a: Yes. It’s free software under the GPL-3.0, with no ads and nothing to buy.

download.a: It isn’t released yet and will come to the Microsoft Store first. Until then, you can build it yourself.

own.q: Do I need to own Minecraft?
own.a: Yes. Once you’ve verified you own Minecraft, offline accounts open up to you.

others.q: Will it touch my other launchers’ instances?
others.a: No. Fluorite plays them where they are, but changes you make in Fluorite don’t sync back to the other launcher. In other words, Fluorite is independent.

report.q: How do I report a bug?
report.a: Open an issue on GitHub. For a security problem, follow the security policy.
